Q5217.reason: An acceptance expressly conditioned on the new loading charge is a counteroffer under UCC 2-207, and nothing shows that counteroffer was accepted.

Q8260.reason: Water is the product formed only by reducing oxygen at the end of the electron transport chain, so its production stops as soon as oxygen is gone.
